meta.name: autoskill
meta.description: Observe the user's screen via screenpipe, detect repeated research workflows, match them against existing scientific-agent-skills, and draft new skills (or composition recipes that chain existing ones) for the patterns not yet covered. Use when the user asks to analyze their recent work and propose skills based on what they actually do. Requires the screenpipe daemon (https://github.com/screenpipe/screenpipe) running locally on port 3030 — the skill has no other data source and will refuse to run if screenpipe is unreachable. All detection runs locally; only redacted cluster summaries reach the LLM.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析你的屏幕操作，自动发现重复研究流程并生成新技能。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常重复相似的研究操作，想把这些模式变成可复用的技能。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often repeat similar research steps and want to turn them into reusable skills.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会读取本地 screenpipe 记录的操作历史,聚类出重复工作流,对照现有技能库,为未覆盖的模式起草新技能或组合配方,并生成提案文件夹供审查。
howto.when: 用户主动要求分析近期工作并提出技能建议时触发;需本地 screenpipe 正常运行,否则拒绝运行。

say.text: 分析我最近一周的操作,提出新技能
say.note: 会生成提案文件夹供你审查

say.text: 看看我重复的工作流,告诉我哪些没被覆盖
say.note: 会输出报告和新技能草稿

say.text: 为我常做的流程找组合配方
say.note: 会生成调用现有技能的配方

howto.what_en: After install, Claude analyzes the user's screen history from local screenpipe, finds repeated workflows, compares them with existing skills, and drafts new skills or composition recipes for uncovered patterns into a review folder.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to analyze recent work and propose skills; requires the local screenpipe daemon running, otherwise it refuses to run.

say_en.text: Analyze my last week of work and propose new skills.
say_en.note: Outputs a proposal folder for your review.

say_en.text: Look at my repeated workflows and tell me what's not covered yet.
say_en.note: Generates a report and skill drafts.

say_en.text: Find composition recipes for workflows I repeat.
say_en.note: Creates a recipe that chains existing skills.
